scope: Only synthetic reporting traces and captured before/gold controls; no real model candidate answers, query logs or scores inspected.

controlsPublication.note: Original controls-only package retained without rewrite. Publication tamper tests use the reviewed current external verify_publication.py against copies; frozen numerical verifier is loaded from the archived package.

cases: runtime hidden status differs from verified case

assertions: both Liger boolean and Triton status schemas map hidden pass
unsupported derived result not successful uptake
visible failing bug not mislabelled passing-control regression

findings.detail: Initial collector glob stopped at parent gold-check directory; changed to descend family subdirectories and verifier now requires all three v3 controls.
When execution summary is present, verifier requires 18 unique planned Liger trial records and exact executed-directory set; not-executed candidates remain explicit.
Report and publication verifier now bind runtime hidden/visible statuses to independently verified cases, normalizing Liger passed boolean and Triton status string.
Publication verifier recomputes exact JS tree identity, candidate file set/before hashes/roles/changed flags, text/applied hashes and evaluator source identity.
Reporting handles undefined, null and empty usage records as missing; per-call completeness requires finite input/output token fields; partial token totals remain a lower bound.
Accepted response count separated from successful derived response count, excluding error/rejected responses from successful uptake.
All visible failures separated from regressions of originally passing visible controls.
verify_archive now binds packaged runtime/contract files directly to pre-generation runtime freeze hashes in addition to snapshot and per-package verification.

gateReview.limitation: Code review only. Actual max generation finish / candidate execution start must be audited after all 36 trials finish.

remainingChecks: Build the final combined package after all actual candidates finish.
Execute verify_archive on a fresh extraction; this review does not claim that not-yet-produced package has passed.
Retain valid/invalid/timeouts and original runtime statuses; use fixed denominator and separate hidden/all-case outcomes.
No claims about actual treatment success, speed, or human understanding are made by these synthetic tests.
